reports.title: How Much Do KDP Books Cost? Price Benchmarks from 508,737 Best Sellers (November 2026)
reports.summary: KDP Best Sellers pricing, estimated sales, Kindle royalties and KU, plus print prices by page count, based on 508,737 books from November 2–8, 2026.
reports.sample: 508,737 books on Amazon.com Best Sellers lists
findings: Amazon Best Sellers covered 508,737 unique books from November 2–8, 2026: 287,153 Print books and 221,584 Kindle eBooks. Median prices were $14.99 for Print books and $6.99 for Kindle eBooks.
During November 2–8, 2026, 63.5% of Amazon Kindle Best Sellers were priced within the $2.99–$9.99 range eligible for the 70% royalty rate. Books priced under $1 accounted for 6.4% of Kindle eBooks.

The largest price band in Amazon Kindle Best Sellers was $5–$10, with 76,835 books representing 34.7% of the store during November 2–8, 2026. The under $1 band had the highest median estimated monthly sales at 9 units.

The largest price band in Amazon Print Best Sellers was $10–$15, with 68,356 books representing 23.8% of the store during November 2–8, 2026. The under $7 band had the highest median estimated monthly sales at 9 units.
Median prices in Amazon Print Best Sellers ranged from $9.99 for books under 50 pages to $24.99 for books with 400+ pages during November 2–8, 2026. The 250–399-page category contained 32,127 books.

reports.title: How Many Reviews Does It Take to Rank on Amazon KDP? Data from 450,681 Best Sellers (November 2026)
reports.summary: How many reviews does it take to rank on Amazon KDP? A comparison of 450,681 books by store, product type, rank tier and category in November 2026.
reports.sample: 450,681 books on Amazon.com Best Sellers lists
findings: Amazon.com Best Sellers lists included 450,681 unique books across Print books and Kindle eBooks during the October 27 to November 8, 2026 data period. The median review count was 55 for Print books and 62 for Kindle eBooks.
Books with fewer than 10 reviews accounted for 25.0% of Print books and 23.7% of Kindle eBooks on Amazon.com Best Sellers in November 2026.
Median review counts on Amazon.com Best Sellers rose with rank in November 2026: 624 at #1, 197 at #2-10, 96 at #11-25, 58 at #26-50 and 37 at #51-100.
Notebook had the lowest median review count among the measured product types on Amazon.com Best Sellers in November 2026, at 7 reviews. Biography & memoir had the highest, at 155 reviews.

Among 23,188 breakout books published during the October 10 to November 8, 2026 report window, the median review count at first reaching an Amazon.com Best Sellers list was 0. A total of 80.7% had fewer than 10 reviews.
